title: Project Filolial
paragraphs: “For now, I’m thinking of gathering scattered information about this Filo girl from various sources.”
“White with sakura-colored feathers?”
“Yeah, and eye color different from the body color, female only. If we gather Filolials that meet those conditions the best, we might get closer to the answer.”
Ohh, Father is using all the power and wealth he has gained to the fullest. And he’s taking care not to waste any effort by avoiding redundancy.

“If we narrow the search area to the vicinity of Melromarc, the probability should go up significantly. Of course, since there’s a chance that Filo might appear due to some conditions, we’ll be raising Filolials on Cal Mira Island as well.”
“You’re doing a lot of complicated things, huh…”
“This is all for Motoyasu’s sake, right?”
As expected of Father. The more power he has, the wider the search area expands.
“Yeah. I owe Motoyasu a lot after all.”
“That’s true. It must be hard not being able to meet the one you love no matter how many times you loop.”
Ren and Itsuki agreed.
Kuh… Ren and Itsuki are good guys this time. I’ve gained new respect for them.
“Éclair, we’re planning to head straight to Melromarc Castle today to ask the queen for assistance. Is that alright?”
“No problem. The waves are being managed among the heroes anyway.”
“So, we’re heading to the castle to search for Filolials. For now, we’re focusing on white Filolials.”
“Hmm… I have mixed feelings about this.”
Oh? Yuki-chan seems to be making a troubled expression.
“The issue is that we don’t know what she looked like as a chick, based on Motoyasu’s information. Considering past trends, she’s probably white, but…”
“The fact that she was born after the summoning makes it problematic. If we act carelessly, we might never meet her…”
“And if what we’ve heard about her being obtained through some kind of lottery is true, even if we follow history, the odds of drawing her are…”
Father muttered these words softly, but they weighed heavily on me.
Ah, Filo-tan, where in the world are you?
“Do we still have to keep Gaelion?”
Sakura-chan asked Father a question from behind me.
“Yeah… The ride isn’t very comfortable…”
Heh, serves him right. But hearing Sakura-chan complain about the uncomfortable ride doesn’t sit well with me. If you didn’t like it, you shouldn’t have come in the first place.
“Once tomorrow’s negotiations are over, we’ll focus on buying Sakura-chan’s relatives before setting out.”
“Sakura’s relatives?”
“Yeah, her little sisters or brothers.”
“Hmm?”
Sakura-chan tilted her head. Filolials don’t have a strong concept of siblings.
“There’s a chance that one of Sakura-chan’s relatives might be a Filolial that Motoyasu loves.”
“Really? Go for it, Motoyasu!”
“Sakura-san is completely detached from the situation.”
“Well, she’s the most laid-back and easygoing of all the Filolials.”
“Ko, are you doing something at the ranch?”
Ren and Itsuki slowly turned their gazes toward Ko.
They’re definitely trying to encourage him to look for a mate, aren’t they?
“I don’t think Kou needs to do anything in particular.”
“Yeah. If you’re going to do anything indecent, do it where we can’t see.”
“Amaki-dono and Kawasumi-dono… well, I’d prefer not to see it either. Kou is…”
“Hmm?”
“Everyone wants Kou to stay a child.”
Father gently patted Ko’s head. This is what they call parental affection.
“Hmm?”
Ko tilted him head even more.
“That being said, if Filolials go into heat, I wonder what will happen…”
“They do.”

I agreed with Father’s muttered words. Filolials do have a mating season. During that time, Filolials tend to get a bit more aggressive. Well, it was quite difficult preventing Filo-tan from making any mistakes back then. Father and the others slowly turned their gaze toward Sakura-chan and the others, then back to me.
“Filolials are indeed angels. Love is important for them.”
“Naofumi, won’t managing the Filolial breeding plan become a huge task for you?”
“I’ll manage it strictly to make sure that doesn’t happen. I’ll also ask the breeder we met today for help.”
“Hmm?”
Ko tilted him head and looked at Itsuki.
Why Itsuki, though?
“Hypothetically, if Kou swarmed me like she did when she was interested in my hair…”
“You’ll just have to do your best.”
“They’re just monsters after all.”
“You’re one too.”
“Even if Gaelion-san says it, it’s not convincing, is it?”

That’s exactly right. It’s absolutely unacceptable to compare the noble Filolials to a lowly dragon. And so, the next day arrived. By the following day, the Filolial breeder had observed the changes in the Filolial that Father registered and had decided to move forward with the deal.
“I’ll take you up on yesterday’s offer.”
The handshake when Father arrived left a strong impression.
“Thank you. We’re planning to depart immediately for Cal Mira Island, which is both a resort and a place where revitalization phenomena occur. Will you be able to join us?”
“It’s not impossible, but…”
“The ship has already been arranged. All that’s left is for you to provide the Filolials, and we can leave right away.”
“Understood. Then I’ll bring the eggs from the warehouse.”
At that moment, Father casually asked a question.

“And about that… Sakura-chan… We’d like to conduct research on the relatives of the sakura-colored Filolial accompanying us. Could you bring along any eggs born from the same pairing as her siblings?”
“Hmm? Give me a moment.”
The breeder seems to be checking Sakura-chan’s details from the list.
“Hmm… it’s not a breed with a pedigree. Honestly, it’s more like the type used for meat or eggs. Can something like this really grow up to be exceptional?”

“Sakura-chan may be a bit laid-back in terms of personality, but she’s extremely talented deep down. Her bloodline is worth researching, but if a Hero is raising her, other qualities might come into play as well. So, could I ask you to help?”
Oh, Father’s rebuttal sounds convincing. The Filolial breeder nodded, acknowledging that it made sense, and despite a bit of effort, gathered all the relevant information.
“This is all I’ve got on hand. After that, tracking them down after they’ve been shipped out is a hassle.”

“Could I ask you to conduct a follow-up investigation? According to the Hero’s legend, a white and sakura-colored female Filolial with this coloration has high potential. I want to see if she can become a queen. Also, it’s said that she needs to be no older than three months.”

Father showed the Filolial breeder the drawing of Filo-tan that I had made. With this method, we’ll naturally be able to find Filo-tan. Ren and Itsuki gave a thumbs-up, clearly impressed. Éclair, on the other hand, let out a sigh as if she was exasperated.
“Hmm… got it. I’ll look into it. With this many conditions, I might be able to find something.”

And so, along with the Filolial breeder, we headed to Cal Mira Island, carrying a large number of Filolial eggs. Now, about Cal Mira Island. We arrived on the island a little later than expected, and by the time we got there, the activation phenomenon was already in full swing. Father and the others, feeling slightly like tourists, were receiving a lecture on the island’s main land. As for me, I was registering all the eggs I had obtained with an excited heart.
“For food, we’ve split the workload between those who’ll process local monsters and feed them on-site and those who’ll use the ingredients we brought.”
“Ah, a consultation with the breeder, right?”
“Apparently, their diet has quite an impact… but I think it’ll be fine.”
“Shouldn’t they be raised more freely?”

“I figured you’d say that, so Motoyasu-kun and the others can raise them however they like. There’s also bound to be some variation between the registered owners. This time, we brought 50 from the cooperating breeder, 35 from Melromarc, and another 35 from Faubrey.”
“That’s a lot to handle…”
Ren said in a somewhat exasperated tone.
What’s so strange about that? In the previous loop, I raised 100 Filolials. Heaven is about to begin again.
The Filolial Project… begins now!

“Basically, the more we have, the better the odds of hitting the jackpot, and we can gather statistical data too. Plus, we want to prepare for the next wave and get cooperation from various countries. There’s a regular meeting scheduled for tonight, so I’ll need your help, Ren.”
“If I remember correctly, according to Motoyasu, we originally discussed ways to strengthen ourselves as Heroes on this island…”
“This time, it’s going to be a Filolial breeding conference… I’m not looking forward to this.”
“I’m excited to see how everyone’s Filolials will grow and change.”
“Let’s take it seriously and do our best!”
Oh? Itsuki looks motivated. That’s the spirit. Working as the hands and feet of Father is the ultimate happiness, after all.
“By the way, Father, did you take a look at the monument we found on this island?”
“I was just about to. You mean that totem pole-looking thing?”
“Yes.”
“Is there magic there?”
“You’ve studied enough to be able to read it, right?”
“It was pretty tough, I say.”

And so, Father and the others read and mastered the magic inscribed on the monument. There won’t be any mistakes like last time. A dreamlike situation is unfolding where all the Heroes are working together to raise Filolials.
Filo-tan, we’re just a little closer to finding you!
